entry.name: rnbo_splat~
entry.digest: Mix values into a buffer with linear interpolated overdubbing
entry.description: splat~ can write values to buffer~ by overdubbing or mixing incoming samples into the current buffer. Real-time mixing can be achieved by specifying a mix amount into the fourth inlet of splat~ . Mixed inputs can also be accumulated and bounded by setting the overdub mode to accum and changing the boundmode, allowing for various types of waveshaping. These functions are applied to both of the two nearest sample values proportionally, according to which is nearer. When dealing with a multichannel buffer, splat~ 's write channel can be modularized using its third inlet.
